item.title: SoundCloud confirms breach after member data stolen, VPN access disrupted
item.description:
📝 SoundCloud acknowledged that a threat actor accessed some of its data but said the exposure was limited in scope. "We understand that a purported threat actor group accessed certain limited data that we hold," SoundCloud told BleepingComputer. Our source said that ShinyHunters is now extorting SoundCloud after allegedly stealing a database containing information about its users.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/soundcloud-confirms-breach-after-member-data-stolen-vpn-access-disrupted/

item.title: The appropriate amount of effort is zero
item.description:
📝 Like I was touching and holding things with 40% more tension than required for that object or activity. Using this definition, it’s clear that the appropriate amount of effort for any activity is zero. The way out of this is to experiment with feeling the unfamiliarity of trying less hard and seeing what it’s like.
🔗 Read more: https://expandingawareness.org/blog/the-appropriate-amount-of-effort-is-zero/
